definitions.gloss: overnight train; night train (a train that runs through the night, often with sleeper cars)
definitions.explanation: A train that travels during the night, allowing passengers to make long-distance trips while sleeping. In Japan, the category traditionally includes sleeper express trains ({寝台|しんだい}{特急|とっきゅう}), though most such services have been discontinued in recent decades.

examples.japanese: {夜行列車|やこうれっしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
{夜行列車|やこうれっしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went all the way to Hokkaido by overnight train.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧、{夜行列車|やこうれっしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When I was young, I traveled around the country by overnight train.

examples.japanese: ⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧⟦{日本|にっぽん}→日本：00320_nippon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{夜行列車|やこうれっしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}っていた→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発達|はったつ}→発達：03559_hattatsu⟧⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}して→消す：00528_kesu⟧いった。
examples.english: Japan once had many overnight trains, but they gradually disappeared as the Shinkansen network developed.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{夜行|やこう}→夜行：04078_yakou⟧ ('running/traveling at night') and ⟦{列車|れっしゃ}→列車：01670_ressha⟧ ('train'). Refers specifically to long-distance trains that operate through the night, as opposed to regular urban or commuter services that happen to run late.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Once a central part of long-distance travel in Japan, overnight trains — particularly sleeper trains (⟦{寝台|しんだい}{列車|れっしゃ}→寝台列車：25984_shindairessha⟧) — have largely been discontinued due to the expansion of the Shinkansen and budget airlines. Only a few remain, such as the luxury cruise train サンライズ⟦{出雲|いずも}→出雲：30792_izumo⟧/{瀬戸|せと}, which retains a nostalgic status among rail fans.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夜行列車|やこうれっしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to take an overnight train
- {夜行列車|やこうれっしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to travel by overnight train
- {夜行列車|やこうれっしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧: an overnight-train journey
- {夜行列車|やこうれっしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{廃止|はいし}→廃止：12483_haishi⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: overnight train is discontinued

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{寝台|しんだい}{列車|れっしゃ}→寝台列車：25984_shindairessha⟧: sleeper train — has beds; overlaps with but is narrower than {夜行列車|やこうれっしゃ}
- ⟦{夜行|やこう}バス→夜行バス：22452_yakoubasu⟧: overnight bus — the modern equivalent for budget travelers
- {夜行便|やこうびん}: night flight/service — used for planes and ships
- ⟦{急行列車|きゅうこうれっしゃ}→急行列車：25988_kyuukouressha⟧: express train — category based on speed, not time of day

REGISTER:
Neutral written and spoken. Particularly common in travel writing, nostalgia pieces, and discussion of rail history.
